notes.title: “Without discerning the body”
notes.intro: Paul warns against eating the bread and drinking the cup in an unworthy manner.

views.label: Recognising Christ’s real presence
views.summary: Catholic, Orthodox and Lutheran Christians understand “discerning the body” as recognising Christ’s body in the sacrament, preparing with confession.

views.label: Recognising the church as Christ’s body
views.summary: Many interpreters see “the body” as the church: the Corinthians were humiliating poorer members at the meal (vv. 20–22).

views.label: Both: examining one’s faith and love
views.summary: Reformed and Methodist Christians call for self-examination of faith, repentance and love before receiving.
